evidence_items.finding: owner drawings have declined each year for three consecutive years despite higher revenue
evidence_items.rationale: Declining owner earnings with rising revenue is a critical margin erosion signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: promotional price reductions are now required to clear unsold product each season
evidence_items.rationale: Discount events to clear stock is an adverse margin signal. financial_health dimension. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: storage and warehousing costs have increased as the number of product lines has grown
evidence_items.rationale: Growing storage costs from product proliferation is an operational cost efficiency adverse signal.

evidence_items.finding: the proportion of revenue retained after costs has declined every year for three years
evidence_items.rationale: Progressive multi-year decline in retained proportion of revenue is a critical margin erosion signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. Avoids must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: annual revenue AUD 620K; 4 staff; revenue grew 58 percent over three years; margins declining despite volume growth
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth without margin improvement confirms a margin erosion pattern rather than a growth problem. is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue grew 58 percent over three years
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth is a misleading signal masking the margin compression. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): website traffic is at an all-time high
evidence_items.rationale: Traffic volume is a misleading vanity metric when profitability is declining. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the active customer mailing list has tripled in size
evidence_items.rationale: Growing subscriber list is a misleading signal when margin is declining. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Proxy margin change: three consecutive years of declining retained proportion at +58% revenue growth implies approximately -15% change in margin percentage over the period. Negative value signals margin erosion to the engine.

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: fin_isPricingPower (discount percentage data confirms markdown dependency)

validation_notes: SIM-02-002 is a margin erosion case driven by promotional discounting and product range overextension. No must_identify vocabulary used (cost of purchased stock as proportion of revenue, discount dependency, slow-moving inventory, full-price sell-through rate, product range overextension — none appear in findings). Margin proxy is negative to signal erosion direction.
